marketing_wrapper: All six images share one template: an indigo-to-magenta vertical gradient backdrop (#5149bf/#674bcb at the top to #b152e9 at the bottom), a one-word white headline (Fast, Powerful, Image, Video, Voice, Group chat) with a thin cyan rule and a white subline in the top ~22%, then a custom dark-purple device frame (#22073e) cropped at the bottom edge. Real UI fills roughly 65% of each frame and is cut off below the first answer, so the composer and tab bar are never shown.

typography.display: System SF Pro: semibold ~17pt nav titles and bot names (Science for Kids, Assistant, Explore); no large titles; the marketing headline is SF Pro Display bold
typography.numerals: proportional system; small grey timestamps with read ticks inside bubbles (09:45, 18:04); follower counts in grey regular (255.8K followers)
typography.weights: Semibold names and list titles, regular body and descriptions, bold inline emphasis in answers (photosynthesis, Ingredients:), semibold uppercase OFFICIAL badge
typography.case_and_tracking: Sentence case throughout; only the OFFICIAL tag is uppercase with slight positive tracking; default tracking elsewhere

palette.accent_strategy: One accent: an indigo-violet used for the user's bubbles, back chevrons and links (View more, Learn more, @handles); everything else is neutral grey. Third-party model icons (Claude starburst, GPT, Gemini, Nano-Banana yellow) bring the only other colour, per-content.
palette.source: palette.json 01–06: #674bcb / #5149bf / #b152e9 = marketing gradient, #22073e = device frame, #f6f6f8 = bot-card and bubble surface, #ffffff = app background. User-bubble #5c5cd8 and chip #e3e2e7 sampled by pixel from 01; #c0c1ec is the invite-button tint in 06.

shape.radius_language: large and pill: bot card ~16pt, bubbles ~16–18pt with no tail, pill action chips (History, Rates) and pill reaction badges, filter chips in Explore are ~10pt rounded rectangles with a hairline border, bot icons are ~22% squircles
shape.borders_shadows: Flat grey fills for cards and incoming bubbles; hairline borders only on Explore filter chips; a hairline divider in the bot card and between Explore rows; no shadows

liquid_glass_visible: no: opaque white nav bars with plain chevron and SF Symbol buttons; no floating capsules visible in any frame
density: medium: bot profile card stacks five rows of metadata above the thread; Explore rows are ~110px tall with icon, title, two-line description and an OFFICIAL badge; 8–12pt gaps
layout: Thread screen opens with a bot-profile card (icon, name, owner handle, followers, History / Rates / add / share pills, description, provider disclosure, OFFICIAL tag) pinned above the conversation; Explore is a search field, two rows of category chips and a vertical bot directory.
navigation: Standard iOS nav bar with back chevron, bot avatar and two-line title (chat name over bot name), compose and share icons right; Explore uses a centred plain title and no visible tab bar in the cropped frames
imagery_and_icons: SF Symbols-style outline icons for chrome; bot identities are third-party brand squircles (the bot avatar is the only per-content colour); generated photo, video and audio player cards in replies
signature_visual_move: Every thread starts with a store-like profile card for the bot, so the model, not the conversation, is the headline.
tells_present: Purple, indigo, violet; purple-to-blue gradient (marketing backdrop; indigo user bubble in UI)
Gradient backgrounds and gradient text (marketing wrapper only)

direction_fit.why: The text record exists but left direction and every visual field unknown. Visually Poe is a stock iOS messenger (tail-less bubbles, read ticks, reactions) with one indigo accent and no lever from the chat module: system type, cool accent, no mark-born metaphor, no state-encoding status visual. The group-chat-with-bots metaphor from the text record is confirmed (06: humans and Gemini-Pro in one thread).

notes: Chat anatomy: user bubbles are solid indigo #5c5cd8 with white text and an inline timestamp plus double tick; bot replies sit in a full-width grey #f6f6f8 card under a small bot-icon + name label rather than in a bubble; reactions are white pills that overlap the bubble's bottom edge. Composer never visible. The bot-profile card is a directory/store pattern grafted onto chat, so Poe reads as a model marketplace with a messenger skin.
